# v1.9 Error Contract

Compact v2.5 stub. Required app-facing fields remain `errors[].kind`, human message, `next_actions`, `original_modified`, and status. Allowed Error Kinds include `missing_input`, `invalid_argument`, `format_error`, `output_conflict`, `missing_optional_backend`, and clean `BLOCKED_CONTROLADO`.
